'''Inaya's ship''' was a personal starship made by [[princess]] [[Inaya]] as a secret before revealing it at the library opening ceremony on her homeworld [[Hazun]].<ref name="Secret Ship" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Inaya's ship first appeared in the episode "[[The Secret Ship]]" from the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|second season]] of the animated series [[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]].<ref name="Secret Ship" /> This ship is modeled by [[Baptiste Tomorszki]].<ref>{{ArtStation|username=baptistetomorszki|url=artwork/bggxbv|name=Baptiste Tomorszki|text=Young Jedi Adventures - Season 2 Ep 03 - Inaya's Ship - Vehicle Modeling}}</ref>
